paper_title: Simple matrix expressions for the curvatures of Grassmannian
summary: Three Major issues: false local sphere-product theorem, incorrect third fundamental form, and incompatible Weyl/Bach normalization. Four Minor groups of explicit normalization/definition/model corrections. Several foundational matrix formulas verified.

problems.title: The asserted local Riemannian sphere product fails a curvature-rank test
problems.check: k2,n6,r4 allowed;dimension8 each. Commutators of tangent basis span so2+so4 dimension7; curvature operator Gram hasrank7. Productfour roundS2 hasrank4. Local isometry preservesrank. Parta additionallyallowsk3,n4,r1 but W0dimension1 in0dim complement;RP3 hasnoembeddedtotallygeodesicS2.
problems.result: Partb false under stated isometric-embedding convention; exponential chart does not establish product geometry. Parta range also too large without k<=n/2.
problems.correction: Replace claimed range with an actually justified product construction; orthogonal4blocks yield globalr<=floor(min(k,n-k)/2). Check mixed curvatures/Lie-triple closure and metric, not only tangent orthogonality.
problems.counterevidence: No claim that all geodesic spheres or the corrected block construction fail; r2 onGr2,4 locally is compatible.

problems.title: Third fundamental form omits the dimension factor on averaged mean curvature
problems.check: For m=k(n-k), correct III=m<II,H>-Ric=(n+2)g/8. OnGr2,4,unitX, six orthonormal normal-basis shape squares sum3/4; printedformula0. For largerdimensions it can be negative.
problems.result: Cor9 and Table1 do not match definition as sum of shape-operator squares.
problems.correction: Use traceII=mH in Gauss contraction; update III=(n+2)g/8=(n+2)tr(X0^TY0)/4.
problems.counterevidence: Second form, shape map, averaged mean and Ricci formulas themselves support the corrected result.

problems.title: Weyl sign is incompatible with Riemann convention and induces false Bach value
problems.check: With K(g)=gXZgYW-gXWgYZ, trace_{2,3}K=-(m-1)g. PrintedW=Rie-lambda K/(m-1) hastrace2lambda g. OnGr1,5,lambda3/8,m4,Wtrace3/4 and printedB9/64; direct curvature hasconstantK1/8, so actualW=B=0.
problems.result: Cor17 computes a non-trace-free tensor, not Weyl; Cor18 is not Bach curvature.
problems.correction: For paperRie convention use W=Rie+lambda K/(m-1) in Einstein case and corresponding Ricci-decomposition signs; genuine Bach vanishes in allowed dimensions.
problems.counterevidence: Printedalgebra follows its faulty definition; correction targets geometric identification, not just arithmetic. CorrectSchouten/Cotton and Einstein property remain.

problems.title: Scalar/delta conventions and maximizing basis need consistent normalization
problems.check: traceRic=2sumunorderedsectionals. Gr2,4:trace1,sum1/2. Eq16bothplanesgive1/8 not1/4. Replacements Bpairs(I/2,K/2),(D/2,J/2)give1/4each. Chenlowerdelta at r2 is0 vsprinted1/2.
problems.result: Definitionsmixfullambienttraceandhalf-tracesubspaces, so advertised delta values require explicit convention.
problems.correction: Chen convention:upperm(n-2)/16,lowerupper-r/4. Fulltrace consistently onsubspaces:upperm(n-2)/8,lowerupper-r/2. If retaining hybrid quantity label it explicitly. Replace maximizing basis.
problems.counterevidence: Attainable extrema0and r/4 forsectional sums are repairable with explicit corrected blocks; not a refutation of the block extremization idea.

problems.title: Jacobi expression has an overall factor of two
problems.result: Cor11 violates the given averaged symmetrization.
problems.correction: Multiply the displayed fullmatrix and block expressions by1/2.

problems.title: Tensor divergence and frame-bundle explanation require correction
problems.check: Same tensor x e tensor e=e tensor x e onR givesprinteddiv0versuse. Actualdiv contracts covariant derivative and differentiatesallfactors. Cocurvature0 followsverticalintegrability;horizontalbundlegenerallynotintegrablewhenR!=0.
problems.result: Printed divergence not well-defined on module tensors; explanation confusesverticalandhorizontalbundles.
problems.correction: Use covariant contraction, horizontal lifts/pullbackTM and verticalfibers; restrict Schouten/Cotton tom>2 and Bach tom>3 or defineextensionsseparately.
problems.counterevidence: Zero torsion/nonmetricity and verticalcocurvature remainvalid; corrected parallel/divergence properties canstillhold.

problems.title: One quotient is the wrong manifold and repeated representative alignment is unnecessary
problems.check: dim GLn/(GLk timesGLn-k)=2k(n-k),notk(n-k). Allhorizontal lifts (d_Qpi)^-1 atfixedQ lieinT_QO(n), contrarytoassertiontheyemergeatdifferentQ.
problems.result: Quotient identification false; extra alignment is an input-format choice rather thaninherent.
problems.correction: Use block uppertriangular parabolic stabilizer. Specify commonQ and lifts once; compare actual algorithms/metric normalizations.
problems.counterevidence: Does not deny practical utility of involution model or any measured stabilityadvantage; none measuredhere.

limitations: Exact acquired published-format PDF only; no other version or later correction was compared.
